reviews.review: This Warhammer 40K game reminds me of cheap plastic. It is such a letdown in so many ways...  Too bad for the Space Marine franchise. It could have been a blast. Why do I think so? Firstly, the violence is nowhere near to what you would expect from a Space Marine game. Then the campaign is boring and the story characters are absolutely grey and uninteresting dudes. This game only contains a handful of Space Marines, some Imperial Guards, a lot of Orks and a touch of Chaos. That's it? Where are the Eldar? No Tyranids? The maps...  Ouch. You would expect to fight on huge battlefields, but no. It consists of bland, mostly deserted tubes and rooms. Not to mention the difficulty. Even on hard, it's just too easy.  It is only fun for an hour maximum, after that it starts to be weary. You just play for its (average) story. The multiplayer is worse because of the balance issues. The only good thing about the game is the late co-op DLC addition: Exterminatus. I only keep going back for that.

Great Multiplayer game, recommended.

Alt tab goodness also included.
Great W40k game, MP is addictive an fun aswell!.

Awesome game, even years after the developer got absorbed, so well-made other games have tried to emulate it (looking at you eternal failsade) great selection of weapons, everything sounds and feels exactly like you would expect, and literally the only downside is the lack of players which I still get lucky on occasion and do an exterminatus with some others looking to enjoy this masterpiece.

Why are you still reading this? buy this game already!

It's a flawed game in the rich Games Workshop universe that defined the grim and gritty far future. Although the setting is fantastic, with chainswords cleaving orks in two, the game is in genral a rather average shooter. If you can get it cheap it is a decent purchase, but not for a full price. 

Space Marine is a game that gives us a glimpse of something awesome but falls on its heads.
